plan.benchmark: Common recorded midpoint at parent start from <=parent_start source prefix, evaluation-only and never passed in Observation/Intent; fixed across policies, scenarios and compute modes. Preserve exact twice-money signed shortfall, fees and residual penalty.
plan.eligibility: Valid complete S observation at parent start after applying all prefix events and watchdogs; consistent safe metadata; no prior-ID overlap. All valid/excluded windows retain source provenance. Order-specific cap exclusions are shared across policies.

horizon_planning_family.joint_plan_semantics: One future action plan evaluated across every environment; no scenario-specific future plan chosen with hindsight

plan.known_data_disclosure: Original 5m study outcomes and the separate 5m archive coverage inspection are already known. The inclusive >=10-tick old threshold yielded no ordinary windows. This is a distinct 15m prospective protocol with strict >10 quote stress and a depth proxy; original study labels/results remain unchanged. No 15m policy outcomes have been evaluated.
plan.normalization_interval: [opening, opening+90 seconds], containing prefixes and all declared parent deadlines. Preserve full raw file and full-window source bounds/counts. Prefix observations exclude winner/resolution labels.
plan.opening_semantics: market_end_at minus 900 seconds; require agreement with final UNIX-second component of 15m market slug
plan.parent_cap: quantity<=10000lots AND <=1% initial min(bid,ask) top10lots; identical cap and remaining penalty for every policy

policy_compute_sensitivity.fallback: Duration>shared1sbudget invokes declared no-op, common remaining penalty. Callback never rerun with future information.
policy_compute_sensitivity.limits: Desktop local-work calibration and fixed-duration sensitivity, not calibrated realtime/colocated latency guarantee.
policy_compute_sensitivity.rule: Before outcome evaluation, benchmark each policy5000times cycling deterministically across first32eligible development prefixes in chronological order; one cold strategy object per call, quantity100lots, buy,30s deadline, no future/policy fills. One warmup per prefix before timed samples. Freeze nearest-rank p99 duration separately for each policy, rounded up to1ms. Use that policy-specific declared duration in measured mode; zero in baseline. Fixed1s decision budget shared by all policies; never expand budget to rescue slow policy. No confirmation measurements. Retain all raw timing samples and p50/p95/p99; no p999 claim from5000samples.

plan.policy_semantics: legacy_horizon remains the original depth/drift sensitivity policy. horizon is the new prefix-only joint latency/liquidity-family policy. Retain all attempted policy failures.
plan.population: All Up-token 15m windows for all eight available assets. Each binary market is one session window. Other outcome tokens are not independent observations. Preserve coin/day/window labels and every exclusion.
plan.prior_market_ids: Exclude every identifier from original 44-window source and prospective 5m coverage inspection; save exact known-ID list and hash before preparation.
prohibited_claims: matched HftBacktest superiority without matched inputs
plan.recording_end: opening+90 seconds, within publisher-declared complete 15m lifetime; explicit modeled recording horizon independent of last payload. It is an archive coverage assumption, not measured network connection liveness.
plan.split: Freeze whole opening UTC days before eligibility/classification; no adaptation if the declared dates have poor coverage. Other dates excluded with reasons. Confirmation never tunes policy parameters or stress threshold.
plan.stability: Report rankings and changes across declared scenarios with unresolved intervals preserved; do not force a reversal or count unresolved outcomes as success
plan.status: registered before any15m policy outcome evaluation; revised compute protocol prior to calibration

stress_proxy.depth_threshold: Sort min(side top10 depth) at parent start over eligible DEVELOPMENT windows, take index floor((n-1)/4); freeze exact integer before any policy evaluation. No confirmation fields affect threshold.
stress_proxy.interpretation: Descriptive prefix quote/depth proxy only; neither a market-wide crisis label nor calibrated stress probability
stress_proxy.name: operational_quote_stress
stress_proxy.rule: stress if prefix spread>10ticks OR min(bid_top10_lots,ask_top10_lots)<development_lower_quartile_lots; ordinary otherwise

plan.timestamp_semantics: exchange_ns=-1 unknown; receive_ns uses capture time only as modeled observation time, not actual receive time
plan.uncertainty: Report paired window and UTC-day aggregates, asset/regime strata and exact day counts. Confirmation may contain one capture day only; do not bootstrap one day into independent multi-day evidence. Any window bootstrap is explicitly conditional and correlated.
plan.watchdog: Snapshot age <=5s allowed; invalidate at last payload+5s+1ns, including terminal silence up to explicit recording_end_ns. Every invalid snapshot becomes G; next valid full S resynchronizes. Sparse unchanged books may be invalidated conservatively, because capture gaps cannot certify liveness.
